summary: SAMEIET EIK NORDRE (org. no. 986 521 224) is a condominium (ESEK) based in Sandefjord, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-04-03. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 97.001 (Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2023 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 781 314 and net income was NOK 453 979. Board chair: Elisabeth Håkestad; auditor: KPMG AS.
